title: 24.4" Steel Bendable Spout Funnel with Filter for All Automotive Oils, Diesel Fuel and Other Liquids, with Gloves
description:
About this item
Steel funnel length: 24.4inch/620mm. Made of steel, more durable to use. Resistant to oil, and not easy to wear.
Flexible Hose: Can be bent at any angle and used in narrow space. It can realize multi-angle liquid infusion and the transportation of liquid in the oil pipeline that is difficult to reach. To meet your different needs.
Easy to Store: The funnel is equipped with a hook, so that it can be held by hand when refueling to prevent the funnel from tilting, make the infusion more stable, convenient to hang on the wall when not in use.
Wide Application: Used to add diesel and other liquids for emergency refueling/refueling of vehicles, such as cars, motorcycles, trucks.
We also prepare a pair of gloves for you to wear when using the tool. If you are unhappy for any reason or there is some problem with our products, you can get help from us. Customer satisfaction is our top priority.

Moreover, the funnel's sleek and modern design not only enhances its aesthetic appeal, but also makes it easy to clean and maintain. reviews_1s:
this thing leaks like no other. I chopped off the flexible metal pipe. I used some clear 3/4 vinyl tubing and connected the funnel and tip. Use a heat gun to get the hose on the funnel and a hose clamp on the tip and use heat to straighten the vinyl tubing. Its good now. lol.This product has been delayed for an extended amount of time. It arrived after the return by date. It finally arrived damaged and completely unusable. The packaging was dirty, partially opened, and appeared to have been opened and closed again previously. I would definitely like a refund please. This item is of no use to me.Needed the item immediately so cant return it, but did not have the gloves listed in the description with it. Otherwise the funnel looks as described, will update after use if there are further issues.I work at a dealership as a technician and after about 4 transmission flush jobs I noticed this thing leaks at the screw connection to the funnel and hose…. Ran all down the outside of the hose and pooled up on the car’s skid plate…. Giant mess. Leaky funnel…

My next step is to buy a long funnel and use PVC glue to connect an old radiator hose that fits snug. I recommend you spend the few extra dollars and just do that. This thing sucks.This funnel is junk. Leaked the first time I used it right at the upper funnel interface above the threads to the hose. I guess I missed the return window by 3 days.I was planning on using this for some basic car work in transferring fluids. I read some other reviews about how this funnel just leaks.
